# PE/COFF image format

- Official source: <https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/debug/pe-format>
- Version: 07/14/2025
- Upstream commit: [`ca8274decead`](https://github.com/MicrosoftDocs/win32/commit/ca8274decead49403d70ceeed4af8d4ca74eaf11) on 2026-10-08T15:26:36Z
- Used by: nie.exe loading and static recompilation (nie-pe, nie-index)

## Facts nie relies on

| Fact | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Offset of the file pointer to the PE signature (`pe_offset_location`) | `0x3c` | [page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MicrosoftDocs/win32/docs/desktop-src/Debug/pe-format.md) |
| PE signature (escaped as in the Markdown source) (`pe_signature`) | `PE\\0\\0` | [page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MicrosoftDocs/win32/docs/desktop-src/Debug/pe-format.md) |
| Optional header magic, PE32 (`magic_pe32`) | `0x10b` | [page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MicrosoftDocs/win32/docs/desktop-src/Debug/pe-format.md) |
| Optional header magic, PE32+ (`magic_pe32_plus`) | `0x20b` | [page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MicrosoftDocs/win32/docs/desktop-src/Debug/pe-format.md) |
| COFF machine type x64 (`machine_amd64`) | `0x8664` | [page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MicrosoftDocs/win32/docs/desktop-src/Debug/pe-format.md) |
| COFF machine type x86 (`machine_i386`) | `0x14c` | [page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MicrosoftDocs/win32/docs/desktop-src/Debug/pe-format.md) |
| COFF machine type ARM64 (`machine_arm64`) | `0xaa64` | [page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MicrosoftDocs/win32/docs/desktop-src/Debug/pe-format.md) |
| DllCharacteristics: ASLR (dynamic base) (`dll_dynamic_base`) | `0x0040` | [page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MicrosoftDocs/win32/docs/desktop-src/Debug/pe-format.md) |
| DllCharacteristics: DEP (NX compatible) (`dll_nx_compat`) | `0x0100` | [page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MicrosoftDocs/win32/docs/desktop-src/Debug/pe-format.md) |
